summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, effective September 24, 2026, replacing its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated September 19, 2024. Citibank, N.A. serves as administrative agent, with a syndicate of joint lead arrangers and bookrunners. The facility provides a $5 billion unsecured senior revolving credit facility plus a $1 billion accordion. The amendment modified treatment of certain hybrid debt instruments. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation, with no equity or deal terms to arbitrage.
